evals.prompt: In my React app that uses Fragiola UI, create a sign-up form with name, email, a country select and a 'subscribe to the newsletter' switch. Show a validation error on the email field.
evals.expected_output: A form built from Field.Root + Field.Row + Field.Body + Input, Select inside Field.Root, Switch inside Field.ChoiceRoot, Field.Root invalid with Field.Error, surface-ring palettes.
expectations: Wraps each Input in Field.Root > Field.Row > Field.Body (no border, background or height classes on the Input)
Puts Select.Root directly inside Field.Root with Select.Trigger > Select.Value, without Field.Row
Puts the Switch (Switch.Root > Switch.Thumb) in Field.ChoiceRoot with a Field.Label linked by htmlFor
Shows the error with Field.Root invalid and Field.Error, not with red color classes or aria-invalid classes
Uses a palette-surface-* class on the fields, and only palette role utilities for color
Imports from the project aliases (@/components/ui/field, @/components/atoms/fields), never from an npm package

evals.prompt: Add a Fragiola dialog that asks the user to confirm deleting a project, with Cancel and Delete buttons.
evals.expected_output: AlertDialog (or Dialog) with Root, Trigger using render, Portal, Backdrop, Content, Header with Title and Description, Footer with Close and a palette-danger Clickable.Button.
expectations: Installs or uses @fragiola/alert-dialog or @fragiola/dialog with the namespace written (npx shadcn@latest add @fragiola/...)
Renders Portal and Backdrop explicitly, and a Title inside Header
Uses render={<Clickable.Button ... />} on Trigger and Close, never asChild
Makes the Delete button destructive with className="palette-danger", not variant="destructive"
Uses Clickable.Button, not a Button component

evals.prompt: Build a settings page section: a card with a heading, a short secondary description and a list of three toggles. The card should be tinted with the purple accent on focus.
evals.expected_output: A div surface with palette-raised and role utilities (no Card component), Text.Heading, text-palette-accent/85 description, Switches in Field.ChoiceRoot with palette-surface-purple.
expectations: Does not import a Card component; builds the surface with palette-raised bg-palette-base border border-palette-line
Writes secondary text with text-palette-accent/85, not text-muted-foreground or another opacity
Uses palette-surface-purple (not palette-purple) for the fields' focus ring
Uses no dark: classes and no Tailwind color scale classes (bg-white, text-gray-500, bg-purple-500)
Uses logical inline properties (ps/pe, ms/me) instead of pl/pr, ml/mr

evals.prompt:
Convert this shadcn button group to Fragiola UI:

Two actions
evals.expected_output: Clickable.Button with palette-danger and render (or Clickable.Link), an icon button with variant="icon" shape="square" and an aria-label, text-palette-accent/85, no shadcn tokens left.
expectations: Replaces asChild with render or with Clickable.Link
Replaces variant="destructive" with className="palette-danger"
Replaces size="icon" with variant="icon" shape="square" and gives the icon button an aria-label
Replaces text-muted-foreground with text-palette-accent/85
Replaces mr-2 with a logical property (me-2) or removes it
Leaves no shadcn token (muted, destructive, primary, foreground, background) in the result

evals.prompt: I need an IDE-like layout with a file editor on the left and a preview on the right, with draggable tabs, using Fragiola UI.
evals.expected_output: npx shadcn@latest add @fragiola/dockable, createModel from @fragiola/dockable-react with a typed LayoutJson, Dockable.Template.Simple from @/components/ui/dockable with a sized root and a surface-tier palette.
expectations: Installs the styled component with npx shadcn@latest add @fragiola/dockable (or uses the headless @fragiola/dockable-react primitives on purpose)
Imports createModel and LayoutJson from @fragiola/dockable-react and Dockable from @/components/ui/dockable
Declares a Types registry and a LayoutJson with version 1 and a root row of two tabsets
Creates the model once (useState(() => createModel<Types>(json)))
Gives the root a size (h-full or a sized container) and a surface-tier palette
Does not invent props or parts that are not in Dockable's docs

evals.prompt: Show 100,000 orders in a grid with sortable columns using Fragiola, styled with the Fragiola UI palettes.
evals.expected_output: npm install @fragiola/data-grid-react, Column definitions, DataGrid.Root with rows, rowKey and a height, DataGrid.Grid with Header and Body, styling through palette roles and data-* attributes.
expectations: Installs @fragiola/data-grid-react with the package manager, not with the shadcn CLI
Gives DataGrid.Root columns, rows, rowKey and a height
Renders DataGrid.Grid with an aria-label, DataGrid.Header and DataGrid.Body
Styles state through data-* attributes (data-active, data-selected, data-sort) with palette role utilities
Does not claim a styled @fragiola/data-grid registry component exists

evals.prompt: Build a dashboard with draggable and resizable widgets with @fragiola/grid-layout, and save the layout when it changes.
evals.expected_output: npm install @fragiola/grid-layout-react, GridLayout.Root controlled with layout + onLayoutChange, Items/Item children function, ResizeHandle and Placeholder, persistence in the app.
expectations: Installs @fragiola/grid-layout-react (the adapter brings the core)
Uses GridLayout.Root with layout and onLayoutChange (controlled) and cols / rowHeight
Renders items with GridLayout.Items and a children function returning GridLayout.Item itemId={item.id}
Adds GridLayout.ResizeHandle with an aria-label and a GridLayout.Placeholder
Keeps persistence in the app (onLayoutChange or model.get("layout")), not as an option of the library

evals.prompt: Which Fragiola components exist for showing a menu of actions, and how do I install the right one? Use the Fragiola MCP server if it is available.
evals.expected_output: Uses search_fragiola or list_components, then get_component or get_docs, then get_install_command; answers with DropdownMenu / ContextMenu as Fragiola UI source installed with the shadcn CLI.
expectations: Calls search_fragiola or list_components before answering, when the server is available
Reads the component with get_component or get_docs before writing code
Gets the install command from get_install_command (npx shadcn@latest add @fragiola/dropdown-menu)
Says the component is source code copied into the project, not an npm package
When the server is unavailable, falls back to fragiola.com docs or npx shadcn@latest view, without inventing tools
